title: Japanese Curry Udon
description: A hearty and flavorful Japanese curry udon dish featuring tender noodles and a rich, savory curry sauce. Serve with a side of steamed vegetables for a delicious and satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat the vegetable broth in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the curry powder and whisk until smooth.
Bring the mixture to a simmer.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until tender.
Add the udon noodles and cook until heated through.
Stir in the coconut milk and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the curry udon hot, garnished with green onions and sesame seeds.
